issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation says 'Đấng Christ không tự tôn vinh mình ĐỂ trở nên thầy tế lễ' (Christ did not glorify himself IN ORDER TO become a high priest), whereas the Greek 'ουχ εαυτον εδοξασεν γενηθηναι αρχιερεα' means 'did not glorify himself [for/as] having become a high priest.' The Greek describes the content of what he did not glorify (his status as high priest), not his motivation or purpose for glorifying himself.

The Vietnamese 'Con là Con Ta' (You are my Son) is a significant deviation from the Greek 'υιος μου ει συ' (you are my son). The Vietnamese adds an extra 'Con' (Son) that changes the direct speech of the Father.
